d:
Experience the magic of 'Crew' with the 'Kiddan Zaalima', starring Tabu, Kareena Kapoor Khan, and Kriti Sanon! Vishal Mishra's beautiful voice and music, along with Raj Shekhar's lyrics, this song will take you on a captivating musical journey."
Song Details :
Song Name - Kiddan Zaalima
Movie Name - Crew
Singer & Music Composer - Vishal Mishra
Lyricist - Raj Shekhar
Actors - Tabu, Kareena Kapoor Khan, Kriti Sanon
Promo : Siddharth R Bharti & Manan Sagar (Studio Vedah)
